points: Festival sale days are the worst time for failures
BHIM is basic but some users say it has never failed them
Linking two bank accounts lets you switch when one bank is down
answer.text: Most people here say reliability depends more on your bank than on the app: when your bank's servers are busy, every UPI app fails. Between the apps, PhonePe and Google Pay are close, with Google Pay slightly ahead in the live battle.

desc: Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM. Which one fails least when you actually need it? #upi
title: Which UPI app is most reliable?
